verdict.rationale: incident.io documents an Insights area with configurable time ranges (current Week/Month/Quarter) and a toggle to compare against the previous period, so it has its own trend-style reliability analytics. The evidence never names the specific metrics in the story. Missing for 10: documented MTTA/MTTR metrics and trends, incident load/volume reporting, on-call health or burden analytics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, I get reliability analytics — MTTA/MTTR trends, incident load, on-call health — to see whether we are actually improving

citations.quote: You can also compare with the previous period by toggling it on.
you can choose to include data from the current Week/Month/Quarter by selecting the "Include this Week/Month/Quarter" configuration found under the custom relative range
